## Summary
Implemented DC-02: New `/register` route with a registration form (name, email, password), client-side validation with enumerated password policy errors, localStorage mock user storage, and a "Register" link on the login page. Extended the existing custom router (no new npm packages).

## Plan Steps Completed
- [x] Step 1: Create `Register.js` — functional component following `Login.js` pattern with `navigateTo` prop
- [x] Step 2: Validation — email regex, individual password rule checks, errors object keyed by field
- [x] Step 3: Submit — stores `{ name, email, password }` in `localStorage.registeredUsers`, redirects to `/login`
- [x] Step 4: Render — reuses `.login-container`, `.login-card`, `.form-group`, `.login-input`, `.login-submit-btn`
- [x] Step 5: App.js auth guard — whitelists `/register` alongside `/login` for unauthenticated access
- [x] Step 6: App.js renderView — `/register` branch returns `<Register navigateTo={navigateTo} />`, passes `navigateTo` to `<Login>`
- [x] Step 7: Login.js — accepts `navigateTo` prop, adds "Register" link below submit button
- [x] Step 8: App.css — adds `.validation-error`, `.password-hint`, `.register-link`, `.register-link-action` styles

## Files Changed
- `src/Register.js` (NEW): 146-line registration component with field state, email/password validation, inline error rendering, localStorage persist, and redirect
- `src/App.js`: Added `Register` import; updated auth guard whitelist and authenticated redirect conditions; added `/register` branch in `renderView`; passed `navigateTo` to `<Login>`
- `src/Login.js`: Added `navigateTo` prop; inserted "Don't have an account? Register" link element below submit button using `register-link` + `register-link-action` classes
- `src/App.css`: Added 4 CSS rule blocks — `.validation-error` (red, 12px), `.password-hint` (muted, 12px, block), `.register-link` (centered, 14px), `.register-link-action` (link-blue with hover transition to `#61dafb`)

## Validation
- [x] Production build passes (`npm run build` — compiled successfully, 0 errors/warnings)
- [x] Unit test suites executed (`npm test` — no test files in project, expected)
- [ ] Docker verification — Docker daemon unavailable in current environment; build-only verification completed

- **Docker**: Must be manually verified when Docker is available (`docker build` + `docker run` on port 8088)
- **Auth guard**: `/register` correctly whitelisted; if authenticated users land on `/register`, they get redirected to `/dashboard`
- **localStorage**: `registeredUsers` is a new key; `isAuthenticated` is untouched — no collision risk
- **No changes to**: `Dashboard.js`, `Confetti.js`, `index.js` — confirmed out of scope
